purpose: Teach: 殴ら/混沌/露骨/濫用/在留/誘発/解任/権益

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下に殴られた人々の証言を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper dealt with testimony from people beaten during wartime, didn't it?
lines.style: Observant, measured opening. Warm curiosity — not interrogating, genuinely interested in his work. Gentle pause before the question, giving him room to engage.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、革命期の混沌とした社会を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the chaos and confusion of society during a revolutionary period.
lines.style: Careful, almost deliberate. Eyes meeting hers. Not rehearsed, but thoughtful — like he's considering how to explain something that matters. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、露骨な人種差別の事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your paper examined explicit cases of racial discrimination, didn't it?
lines.style: Slightly slower tempo. Gentle but direct — she's checking that he's aware of the weight of his subject. Warm regard underneath the question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、権力の濫用の事例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at instances of abuse of power throughout those contexts.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Matter-of-fact, without coldness. He's explained this before, perhaps, or he's simply clear on his thesis. Even breath, steady gaze.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 在留外国人の権利問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You examined the rights of foreign residents in your work, correct?
lines.style: Engaged but not pushing. A colleague recognizing colleague work. Interest is genuine. Slight lift at the end, inviting his perspective.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、災害が誘発する社会問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I investigated how disasters trigger deeper social problems.
lines.style: Quieter here — like he's moved to ground he's more certain of. Unhurried. A shift in his posture, slightly more at ease than before.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、大臣解任の歴史的経緯を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper also covered the historical circumstances surrounding a minister's removal, didn't it?
lines.style: Reflective pause before starting. She's drawing connections, thinking aloud a little. Warm but genuinely curious about the scope of his research.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、海洋権益の国際紛争を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I studied the international disputes over maritime territorial rights.
lines.style: Closing thought — voice settles slightly. Not rushed, but with a sense of landing. Small breath at the end, like he's summarizing. Still present, but finishing.
